nodes.name: AiResults.tsx
nodes.summary: Ticket-level AI panel with buttons that run Jev or the LLM on demand, the ticket's run history and its comparisons. Each successful run offers a 'Use this answer' action that seeds the final classification form.

nodes.name: FinalClassification.tsx
nodes.summary: Panel where the operator views and sets a ticket's final classification, by hand or starting from an AI answer. The value changes only on Save, escalation has no default, and changing category clears the subcategory.

nodes.name: ImportExport.tsx
nodes.summary: CSV import dialog with a dry-run check that reports valid, invalid and duplicate rows before anything is saved, plus download links for the ticket, execution and comparison CSV exports.

nodes.name: NewTicketPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Page that loads the taxonomy, renders the ticket form and, once the API confirms creation, shows a success state with a link to the new ticket. No AI runs on creation.

nodes.name: TicketDetailPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Ticket detail page composing ticket info, status select, edit form, final classification, AI results, internal notes and confirmed deletion. Status changes and edits appear only after the API confirms them.

nodes.name: TicketForm.tsx
nodes.summary: Shared create and edit form for tickets, validated client-side with a Zod schema that mirrors the backend's schema. Blank optional fields are sent as null, and the description is kept untrimmed.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses react-hook-form with a Zod resolver; the Radix-based select is wired in through Controller because it is not a native input.

nodes.name: TicketListPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Ticket list page with search, taxonomy filters, sort and pagination kept in the URL, plus import and export actions. Rows navigate to the ticket and show its final classification and latest AI run.

nodes.name: RunButton
nodes.summary: Button that runs one provider on the ticket and toasts the outcome, disabled while the run is pending.

nodes.name: RunRow
nodes.summary: One run's model, status, answer, error, timing, tokens and cost, with a 'Use this answer' button when it succeeded.

nodes.name: RunHistory
nodes.summary: Lists the ticket's newest runs with loading, error and empty states and a link to the full log when there are more.

nodes.name: ComparisonHistory
nodes.summary: Shows up to 50 comparisons for the ticket, or nothing when there are none.

nodes.name: AiResults
nodes.summary: Card combining the Jev and LLM run buttons, the link to Compare, run history and comparison history.

nodes.name: startingValues
nodes.summary: Builds the form's starting values from an AI or saved answer, or empty values when there is none.

nodes.name: Field
nodes.summary: Labelled select used for each classification field, disabled when it has no options.

nodes.name: FinalForm
nodes.summary: Form editing the five classification fields; it requires all of them and saves the source run ID when an AI answer was used.

nodes.name: SavedFinal
nodes.summary: Read-only view of the saved classification and whether it came from an AI answer, an edited one or by hand.

nodes.name: FormLoader
nodes.summary: Loads the taxonomy, with loading and error states, before rendering the final classification form.

nodes.name: FinalClassificationPanel
nodes.summary: Card switching between the saved answer and the form, opening automatically when an AI answer is chosen and restarting the form for a different one.

nodes.name: SummaryView
nodes.summary: Renders an import summary: counts, duplicate rows, a per-row error table and a preview of the first rows.

nodes.name: ImportDialog
nodes.summary: Dialog that checks a chosen CSV with a dry run and enables the real import only after a successful check with rows to import.

nodes.name: ExportLinks
nodes.summary: Download links for the tickets, executions and comparisons CSV exports.

nodes.name: NewTicketPage
nodes.summary: Loads the taxonomy, submits the ticket form and shows a confirmation with next actions after creation.

nodes.name: StatusSelect
nodes.summary: Select controlled by the saved status, so it changes only after the API confirms the update.

nodes.name: TicketInfo
nodes.summary: Card showing the ticket description with line breaks preserved, plus customer, order and channel details.

nodes.name: Notes
nodes.summary: Lists internal operator notes and provides a form to add one.

nodes.name: TicketView
nodes.summary: Composes the ticket's header actions, edit form or info, final classification, AI results, notes and delete confirmation, and passes a chosen AI answer to the final panel.

nodes.name: TicketDetailPage
nodes.summary: Loads the ticket named in the route and renders it, with loading, not-found and error states.

nodes.name: Field
nodes.summary: Form row with a label, a control and an inline error message linked by ID.

nodes.name: TicketForm
nodes.summary: Validated create and edit form with accessible error wiring; converts blank optional fields to null on submit.

nodes.name: useListParams
nodes.summary: Exposes the list's URL search parameters as a ticket query and updates them, resetting to page 1 when a filter changes.

nodes.name: Filters
nodes.summary: Search box, taxonomy filters and sort select that write to the URL.

nodes.name: TicketRow
nodes.summary: Clickable table row showing a ticket's ID, customer, final classification, status, creation time and latest AI run.

nodes.name: NoTickets
nodes.summary: Empty state offering to clear filters when filtered, or to create or import tickets otherwise.

nodes.name: TicketTable
nodes.summary: Ticket table with its column headers and one row per ticket.

nodes.name: TicketListPage
nodes.summary: Connects URL parameters to the ticket query and renders import and export actions, filters and the matching list state.
